items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: and Luke Palmer played the sousaphone

ctx.x: They had the one trombone, Butch Rose(?), the trombone player. Then we had Clarence Holliston playing the lead alto, I played the third alto part, and Lucious Stokes played the tenor.

And in the rhythm section, we had Paul Gayten playing the piano, and Luke Palmer played the sousaphone, and H.G. Hennington playing the tenor guitar and the banjo, and Mark Hannah(?) played the drums -- a very excellent drummer.
